    int n;

    std::cin >> n >> inp;

    int maxl = -1, curl = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (inp[i] == '_') {
            if (curl > maxl) maxl = curl;
            curl = 0;
            continue;
        } else if (inp[i] != '(' && inp[i] != ')') {
            ++curl;
        } else {
            if (curl > maxl) maxl = curl;
            curl = 0;
            ++i;
            while (inp[i] != ')') ++i;
        }
    }
    if (curl > maxl) maxl = curl;

    int numwrd = 0;
    curl = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        while (i < n && inp[i] != '(') ++i;
        if (i == n) break;
        ++i;
        while (inp[i] != ')') {
            if (inp[i] == '_') {
                if (curl > 0) ++numwrd;
                curl = 0;
            } else if (inp[i] != '_') {
                ++curl;
            }
            ++i;
        }
        if (curl > 0) ++numwrd;
        curl = 0;
    }

    std::cout << maxl << " " << numwrd << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
